name: UnbalancedCovers.direct_short_quotient
statement: theorem direct_short_quotient {R : Type} [CommRing R] (a b c d x : R) : 27*a^2*(a*x^6+b*x^4+c*x^2+d) = (3*a*x^2+b)^3+(9*a*c-3*b^2)*(3*a*x^2+b)+ (2*b^3-9*a*b*c+27*a^2*d)

name: UnbalancedCovers.reciprocal_short_quotient
statement: theorem reciprocal_short_quotient {R : Type} [CommRing R] (a b c d x : R) : 27*a^2*(a+b*x^2+c*x^4+d*x^6) = (3*a+b*x^2)^3+(9*a*c-3*b^2)*(3*a+b*x^2)*x^4+ (2*b^3-9*a*b*c+27*a^2*d)*x^6
